name: Gravid Space
source:
Our poor little buddy, Tenfour here just woke up to find himself aboard an alien spaceship, only to discover all the hot alien truckers are pregnant - and he's the father.

[I]Uh-oh.[/i]

[From [url=https://gnollhole.itch.io/gravid-space]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们这可怜的小老弟滕福尔刚睡醒，就发现自己在一艘外星飞船上。接着他发现，船上那些性感的外星货车司机全都怀孕了，而他就是孩子们的爹。

[i]哎呀，糟了。[/i]
